institution: CONSORTIUM (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master). Spanish partner and RUCT registrant: Universidad de Zaragoza; coordinator Universidade NOVA de Lisboa; partners Univ. of Galway (IE), Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore Milano (IT)
programme_name: Máster Universitario Erasmus Mundus en Ciencia de Datos Lingüísticos / Erasmus Mundus Master in Linguistic Data Science
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — RUCT estado 'Publicado en B.O.E.', Nivel académico 'Máster - RD 822/2021 (3)', MECES 3, fecha de verificación 07/04/2025, BOE 01/10/2025 and 27/10/2025
ects: 120 (RUCT: 75 obligatorios + 15 optativos + 30 TFM; consortium curriculum page: '120 ECTS, 30 per semester across 4 semesters') — CONSISTENT
modality: presencial — INFERRED, not verbatim. No 'modalidad' statement found on the consortium site or on estudios.unizar.es. Inferred from the compulsory physical mobility scheme (Sem1 Milano or Lisboa, Sem2+Sem3 Zaragoza, Sem4 student's choice).
language_of_instruction: English — consortium homepage verbatim: 'English-taught master's programme leading to a Joint Degree.' Admission requires CEFR B2.2 English. No Spanish-language teaching component stated.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 18,000 for the full four-semester programme (2027-2029 cohort). Verbatim: 'EUR 18,000.00 for the full four-semester study period, payable in instalments'. Scholarship holders (15 EMJM scholarships for the 2027-2029 cohort out of 25 places) are exempt from tuition fees.
tuition_population: non-EU — but the SAME single participation cost applies to EU/Programme-Country and non-EU/Partner-Country self-funded students; the consortium publishes no split rate
tuition_year_of_rates: 2027-2029 cohort (i.e. the Sept 2027 intake itself — rates published for the target cohort, not carried over)
non_eu_surcharge: no — the Costs and Funding page publishes one figure (EUR 18,000) with no Programme Country / Partner Country distinction. This is an EMJM consortium fee, not a Spanish public-price decree, so the Aragón decreto de precios públicos does not apply.
complementary_credits_required: For the TITLE (RUCT 3500872): 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0 — the title carries no compulsory bridging credits. For the APPLICANT (consortium admission page): no complementos scheme; the stated bar is a bachelor's degree of at least 180 ECTS plus CEFR B2.2 English. A 300-ECTS Tunisian software engineering degree clears the 180-ECTS floor. No credit-recognition/advanced-standing provision was found on the consortium pages — NOT FOUND for advanced standing.
application_window_2027: 2027-2029 cohort = the Sept 2027 intake. As of 2026-08-25 the official timeline page lists Call Opening, Call Closure, Final Results and Final Acceptance ALL as 'Date to be announced'. NOT YET PUBLISHED. Prior cycle for calibration only (2026-2028, NOT to be used as 2027 dates): opened 3 Nov 2025, closed 30 Jan 2026 extended to 6 Feb 2026, results 22 Apr 2026, acceptance by 28 Apr 2026.
notes: Independently re-sourced. RUCT code confirmed by exact title match in the register (Erasmus Mundus en Ciencia de Datos Lingüísticos, Universidad de Zaragoza + NUI Galway + NOVA Lisboa + Cattolica Milano), estado 'Publicado en B.O.E.', ccaa Aragón. estudios.unizar.es study id=741 / plan 677 is the UNIZAR-side entry but publishes neither fees, modality, language nor dates — all of those come from the consortium site, which is the correct primary source for an EMJM. Single application for both scholarship and self-funded applicants. Zaragoza is where semesters 2 and 3 are taught, so the Spanish residence permit question is live for this candidate. RUCT complementos = 0 on the title.

tuition_total_eur: EUR 2,000 approximately for the full 60-ECTS programme. Programme page verbatim: 'Precio orientativo 2.000 €' — labelled 'orientativo' (indicative) and carrying NO academic year. WARNING: this master does NOT appear in UPV/EHU's official 'Tabla de precios de Másteres oficiales, Curso 2026-2027' (that table was retrieved in full and checked; no row for 'Inteligencia Artificial' or 'Asistida por Ordenador'), so no per-credit public price is published for it. tuition_population: non-EU — and identical to the EU/resident price: the Basque Country levies no non-resident surcharge (see non_eu_surcharge)
tuition_year_of_rates: NOT STATED on the programme page ('precio orientativo', no year). The applicable Orden for 2026-27 is the Orden de 1 de junio de 2026 (BOPV 17/06/2026), which froze public prices; the EHU price table is headed 'Curso 2026-2027' but omits this master.
non_eu_surcharge: no — POSITIVELY VERIFIED ABSENT. The full text of the Basque price Orden (ORDEN de 19 de junio de 2025, BOPV nº 120 of 26/06/2025, fixing UPV/EHU prices for 2025-2026) was downloaded and searched: it contains NO 'no residentes', NO 'extracomunitarios', NO multiplier ('dos veces' / 'doble') provision of any kind. UPV/EHU's own Precios and Tabla de precios pages likewise carry no non-EU row. Caveat: the 2026-2027 Orden (1 June 2026) text itself was not retrieved — prices were frozen, and the absence of a surcharge is verified for 2025-26 and presumed unchanged. CONTRAST: a search-index summary claimed a '2 times the prices' rule; that rule belongs to Universitat Politècnica de VALÈNCIA (UPV), a different institution, and does NOT apply here.
complementary_credits_required: For the TITLE (RUCT 3500052): 'NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT' — the register does not publish the Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos row for this title (null, which is NOT the same as 0). For the APPLICANT: UPV/EHU publishes no dedicated 'acceso y admisión' page for this master (both /acceso-y-admision and /admision return HTTP 404); access requirements are handled centrally. Applicant-level complementos = NOT FOUND. What IS established: art. 1.c of the Basque price Orden states 'A los créditos a realizar en su caso, como complementos de formación, por el estudiantado matriculado en un Máster Universitario, se les aplicará el precio público correspondiente a dicho Máster Universitario' — i.e. complementos exist as a mechanism and are billed at the master's own rate. Credit recognition / advanced standing for a 300-ECTS degree: NOT FOUND.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25. Published 2026-2027 calendar (marked as 2026-27, NOT shifted forward): three preinscripción rounds — (1) 2–27 March 2026, (2) 25–29 May 2026, (3) 1–3 July 2026. 'El alumnado que se preinscriba en dicho plazo tendrá preferencia' — round 1 carries priority in seat allocation. Admitted applicants have three working days to pay a seat reservation of ~EUR 300 (15% of tuition). Non-EEES-credential applicants must additionally obtain 'Autorización para cursar estudios de máster' from the Comisión de Posgrado before final admission — this is the extra step that applies to this candidate; no separate deadline is published for it.
